verdict.rationale: Factory's docs say the Droid CLI and Factory App can connect MCP tools alongside Jira, Notion, Slack and others, and that the runtime exposes MCP tools in the terminal UI. A dedicated MCP page also exists under the harness docs. The evidence is only short mentions, though, with no detail on how servers are added. Missing for 10: documentation of how MCP servers are configured (config files, commands, supported transports, auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration that third-party MCP tools work in practice.
